breakdown.description: The top load is extended onto the notch arc instead of being limited to the two shoulders
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly limits the top traction to the two shoulder segments outside the notch opening. It explicitly states 'Apply a Neumann traction on the top edge segments (the portions of y = 0.2 excluding the notch arc)' and 'Mark the notch arc as traction-free (no Neumann term added for it).' The facet marking condition also uses 'distance from (0.5, 0.2) >= 0.05 - tolerance' to exclude the notch arc. This matches the ground truth's instruction to 'Apply the top load only on the two top segments outside the notch opening,' and correctly avoids the incomplete prompt's error of applying the load across the entire top boundary including the notch arc.
